name: Click Corrector
description: Click a few frames early and the mod holds the click back until the right frame.

enabled.name: Correct My Clicks
enabled.description: Master switch. When on, a click that comes a little <cy>early</c> is held back and sent on the frame of the matching click in the level's reference run.

frames-early.name: Frames Early
frames-early.description:
How many frames <cy>before</c> the right moment a click may come and still be corrected. With <cg>10</c>, a click that is 1 to 10 frames early is moved to the right frame; a click 11 or more frames early is left alone.

A frame here is one physics tick, <cy>1/240 s</c> (10 frames = about 42 ms). Late clicks can never be corrected.

correct-releases.name: Correct Releases Too
correct-releases.description: Also hold back <cy>letting go</c> of the button when you release a little early. Matters for ship, wave, robot and other parts where the length of the hold counts.

learn.name: Learn From My Completions
learn.description: Whenever you beat a level from the start (normal mode, or practice mode with checkpoints), save the clicks of that run as the level's reference. Turn off to keep a macro you imported.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: When at least one click was corrected in an attempt, that attempt does <cr>not</c> save a new best or a completion. Corrected runs are assisted runs: turn this off only for levels where that does not matter to anyone else.

show-hud.name: Show Counter
show-hud.description: Show a small counter in the corner with how many clicks were corrected this attempt.
